headline: RBI issues RRB KYC Second Amendment Directions, 2026
reference: Reserve Bank of India (Regional Rural Banks - Know Your Customer) Second Amendment Directions, 2026
summary_points: RBI has published the Regional Rural Banks (Know Your Customer) Second Amendment Directions, 2026 on its notifications page.
The instrument amends the existing KYC Directions applicable to Regional Rural Banks.
The page text available does not set out the specific amendments, issue date or effective date.
Details are in the linked PDF (about 241 kb), which should be read for the exact changes.
who_is_affected: Regional Rural Banks and their compliance teams, and customers undergoing KYC with RRBs, are likely to be affected.
action_required: Read the full Directions on the RBI website to identify the amended KYC provisions and update RRB policies and procedures accordingly.

RBI has issued the Reserve Bank of India (Regional Rural Banks - Know Your Customer) Second Amendment Directions, 2026.

The Directions amend the existing KYC framework applicable to Regional Rural Banks (RRBs).

The notification page lists the title and a downloadable PDF, but the specific amendments, issue date and effective date are not visible in the page text. Compliance teams at RRBs, and professionals advising them, should read the full document to understand exactly which KYC provisions have changed.

Practical next steps:
- Download and review the Directions
- Compare them with the current RRB KYC policy
- Update onboarding, periodic updation and monitoring procedures as needed

Please verify the details with the official RBI source before acting.
